instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside an outdoor covered concrete pavilion, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) stands on the left, back partially to the camera, holding his black boxing gloves up defensively near his face. Opposite him, the man in the green long-sleeved shirt (R3) stands on the right wearing red shorts and grey clogs, holding up two focus mitts and looking intently at R1. The two are positioned close together, preparing for the next sequence of pad work under bright, natural daylight.
